title: No cost per deal: LLM, Apify and operator time are not attributed to the deal
evidence: shared/llm_gateway/tracker.py records caller / model / tokens with no deal id; Apify spend is metered per scan (apify.start_cost_meter → scan_cost) not per prospect / deal (enrichment, re-screen, contact refresh run per deal); no measure of operator decisions per deal beyond the prospect desk's effort count
impact: The founder cannot see which corridor or deal size pays for its own cost — unit economics stay a guess, so effort keeps going to deals that lose money after cost
fix: Tag LLM calls and Apify runs with deal_id (context var set by the continuation / route), add operator decision count and time-to-decide per deal, and show cost per deal next to realised margin on Money & Margin
why_money: effort goes to the corridors whose margin covers their cost
